_readme: Everything about your group lives here. Edit this file (not the code) to change times, location, or links. Times are 24h 'HH:MM' in the group's timezone. day: 0=Sunday ... 4=Thursday ... 6=Saturday.

group.name: Berkeley Rueda de Casino
group.tagline: Cuban salsa in a circle. Thursdays on the lawn. Everyone welcome, always free.

location.name: Valley Life Sciences Building — north side (outdoors)
location.detail: On UC Berkeley's campus — we're the circle of people on the grass on the north side of VLSB. If the weather turns, check the Tonight tab before you set off.

schedule.title: Beginner + Intermediate classes
schedule.note: Two classes side by side, open to everyone. No partner, no experience, no cost.

schedule.title: Social dancing at Comal
schedule.note: Jose spins Latin music on vinyl. Free, and no pressure to dance.

whatToWear.intro: We're outdoors on the lawn, and we dance on the concrete path beside it — so:
tips: Comfortable, flat shoes you can pivot in. Trainers with a smooth sole are perfect. Concrete is hard on knees and unkind to thin heels.
Dress for the weather rather than for a dance floor — there's a forecast for class time on the Tonight tab.
Layers you can peel off. You'll warm up fast, then cool down just as fast once the sun goes.
Something you don't mind sweating in. Bring water.

weather.note: Open-Meteo, no API key needed. Set enabled=false to hide the outdoor forecast.
